summary: Phase J — Multi-currency FX (/api/currency/rates), product recommendations (/api/products/{id}/recommendations), wishlist page, LangCurrencyMenu (EN/HI + 6 currencies), RelatedProducts + RecentlyViewed, currency-aware cart drawer & checkout INR-conversion note. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed. Frontend: all e2e scenarios passed EXCEPT ONE — 'Move all to bag' on /wishlist adds items to cart but does not remove them from wishlist (inconsistent with single-item 'Move to bag').

ui_bugs.issue: 'Move all to bag' button adds every wishlist product to the cart but does NOT call toggleWishlist(p) to remove them. After clicking Move-all: cart badge=2 (correct), wishlist still shows 2 items with hearts filled (wrong). Single-item moveOne() correctly does both (addToCart + toggleWishlist). Fix: change moveAll to `wishlist.forEach(p => { addToCart(p,1); toggleWishlist(p); });` OR call a new clearWishlist() after the loop. File: /app/frontend/src/pages/Wishlist.jsx L24-28.

action_items: Fix Wishlist.jsx moveAll() to also remove items from wishlist after moving them to cart (parity with moveOne). One-line fix at L24-28 of /app/frontend/src/pages/Wishlist.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L262-315 product_recommendations: 3-tier fallback (category -> shared collections -> top-rated store-wide) with dedup via `seen` set. Always excludes source pid. Attaches category_slug/category_name to items via a single batch cats query (good, no N+1). LGTM.

server.py L529-550 currency_rates: allows admin override via settings key CURRENCY_RATES (JSON dict of {CODE:rate}). Parsing is defensive (try/except for both JSON and float coercion). Default INR base rate hardcoded — safe.

CurrencyContext.jsx L27-31: fetches /api/currency/rates on mount, but if it fails (network) silently keeps FALLBACK. Good — no user-visible error. Consider adding a soft toast/telemetry for observability.

CurrencyContext.jsx L42-57 format(): uses Intl.NumberFormat with locale + currency style; falls back to `${symbol}${amount.toFixed(decimals)}` if locale unsupported. Handles null/NaN by returning '' (good — no 'NaN' leaking into UI).

LangCurrencyMenu.jsx L48-58: language buttons do NOT call setOpen(false) after selecting. Currency buttons DO. Inconsistent UX — after picking Hindi the menu stays open until user clicks outside. Minor UX nit, not functional.
Wishlist.jsx L24-28 moveAll(): BUG — does not remove items from wishlist after adding to cart. moveOne (L30-34) correctly does both. This is the only functional defect found in Phase J.
RelatedProducts.jsx L26 short-circuit `if (!loading && items.length === 0) return null;` — the section vanishes when API returns 0. Good graceful degradation.
useRecentlyViewed hook is localStorage-backed; RecentlyViewed.jsx L18 correctly filters excludeId before slicing to 8. Section hidden when empty.
i18n.js L147: uses `localStorage.getItem` at module init time without waiting for DOMContentLoaded — fine in CRA env because window is guarded, but SSR-unsafe (n/a for this app).

Console noise: 401s on /api/admin/integrations during public page loads — this is a public visitor probing an admin-gated endpoint (expected, not a bug). Consider guarding the fetch behind an isAuthenticated check to reduce console noise.

success_rate.frontend: 94% (16/17 UI scenarios passed; 1 failure: wishlist move-all doesn't clear wishlist)

test_credentials: Not required — all Phase J endpoints and pages are public.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 15 products from live catalog. No data mutated. localStorage cleared before each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase J (currency + recommendations + wishlist + i18n) largely verified end-to-end. All 14 backend pytest cases and 16 of 17 UI scenarios pass. Single defect: Wishlist.jsx moveAll() does not remove items from wishlist. All other flows — heart-to-wishlist, nav badge, related products (8 cards), recently viewed cross-product, currency switch (INR/USD/EUR/GBP), language switch (EN/HI both directions), localStorage persistence, cart drawer currency, checkout total + INR conversion note — verified working. Note on /api/reviews path: the review_request said 'spot-check /api/reviews/generic' but that endpoint does not exist; the correct list endpoint is /api/reviews (verified 200).
rca_of_the_issue: Wishlist move-all bug: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Wishlist.jsx moveAll() at L24-28 iterates wishlist and only calls addToCart(p,1) — it never calls toggleWishlist(p). By contrast moveOne() at L30-34 calls both. Fix: `wishlist.forEach(p => { addToCart(p,1); toggleWishlist(p); });` — order matters (add first, then toggle to remove from wishlist, matching moveOne). Reproduction: add 2 items to wishlist, click [data-testid=wishlist-move-all]; observe cart badge=2 (correct) but wishlist items still present (bug). Mitigation: trivial one-liner as above OR expose a dedicated clearWishlist() from CartContext and call it after the forEach.
